title: Upgrade Kiichain Testnet Oro to v8.0.1
summary:
Coordinated upgrade of Kiichain Testnet Oro to v8.0.1.

The upgrade is scheduled for Monday 2026-10-26 around 17:00:00 UTC (block height 36,425,300). Height is estimated from the Oro block time over the 100,000 blocks ending 2026-10-22 16:07 UTC and should be rechecked before this proposal is submitted.

Validators should download the v8.0.1 binary, verify the checksum, and stage it in cosmovisor under the upgrade plan name v8.0.1 before the upgrade height.

This plan name matches the v8.0.1 upgrade handler, which runs module migrations.

Binaries and checksums are not published yet. Fill them in from the v8.0.1 release before submitting this proposal.
